name: Alloy
description:
Alloy is an AI prototyping tool that lets product managers, designers, and founders build interactive prototypes using their existing product, not a blank canvas. Connect Alloy to Claude to capture, clone, and modify web apps and websites, then iterate with AI cloud agents that run in the background.

With the Alloy connector, Claude can:

Clone any website or web app — capture live pages with Alloy's website cloner and turn them into editable, high-fidelity prototypes in seconds
Prototype on your existing product — import your real UI via browser capture and test new features, flows, and redesigns in context, without engineering time

Run cloud agents — delegate multi-step prototyping and editing tasks to Alloy's AI agents and pull results back into your Claude conversation

Manage projects and prototypes — create, list, edit, and share Alloy projects directly from Claude

Alloy is built for product teams who need to communicate ideas visually: PMs validating concepts before writing a PRD, designers exploring variants of live pages, and founders demoing features that don't exist yet. Unlike generic AI app builders, Alloy works from your existing product's real code and design system, so prototypes look and feel like the real thing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alloy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alloy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.alloy.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alloy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alloy provides these MCP tools: getAgentSession, getAgentSessionChatMessages, getAgentSessionFileContent, getAgentSessionFiles, and getAgentSessions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alloy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alloy in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Alloy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alloy is developed by Alloy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
